condo: Freehold in D14, within 1km to Kong Hwa Primary

history.summary: Freehold 3BR in D14 at $2.0M / $1955 PSF — squarely in the deepest-liquidity quantum band, 300m from Aljunied MRT and within 1km of Kong Hwa Primary (a genuine school-catchment demand driver). Strongest arena record in the batch (Elo 1316, 339-224-6). The PSF is full for D14 and the listing is somewhat opaque (null built_year, generic name, compact 1023 sqft for a 3BR).
history.rating_rationale: Several investment positives align: freehold tenure, a $2.0M quantum at the heart of the liquid sweet spot, 300m walkable to Aljunied MRT (East-West Line), a recognized primary-school catchment that sustains family demand, and Paya Lebar Central regeneration as a district catalyst. The arena agrees — best Elo (1316) and win record (339-224-6) in the batch. Caveats: $1955 PSF is on the full side for D14/Geylang and the listing lacks a built_year and project name, so this is a conviction on the location/tenure/quantum profile rather than a specific verified project. Net positive enough for a Buy at medium confidence.

Null built_year and generic listing name — specific project/age unverified
1023 sqft is compact for a 3BR — efficient but could be a 'small 3BR' that rents/sells closer to a large 2BR
No URA appreciation/txn data to confirm trend
